name: Aiden Jager
source:
Aiden is chatty, kind of flirty, and makes you laugh – online, that is.

You meet Aiden playing a popular online game and you want to meet up. Except when you do finally meet him, you realize... you've been catfished! In reality, Aiden is a bumbling fool whose social anxiety forces him to keep running away from your wrath.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/939330/Tailor_Tales/]Steam[/url]]
